article_title: Bentley's first electric car, the Torcal, to be built in Crewe

tasks.prompt: What is the main focus of the article?
options: Bentley has unveiled its first fully electric car and is upgrading its Crewe factory to build it.
Bentley is closing its Crewe factory and moving production abroad.
The UK government has cancelled its plans to support electric vehicles.
Bentley has decided to produce only petrol-powered racing cars.
tasks.correct_answer: Bentley has unveiled its first fully electric car and is upgrading its Crewe factory to build it.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה עוסקת בחשיפת ה־Torcal, הרכב החשמלי הראשון של בנטלי, ובהשקעה בקו ייצור חדש במפעל בקרו.

tasks.prompt: How much has Bentley invested in upgrading its Cheshire factory?
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לפי הכתבה, בנטלי השקיעה 350 מיליון ליש״ט בשדרוג המפעל בצ'שייר.

tasks.prompt: In the article, what does “strong headwinds” mean for the UK motor industry?
options: Favourable weather for testing cars
A rapid rise in customer demand
Serious difficulties or pressures
New rules about factory ventilation
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הביטוי strong headwinds משמש באופן מטפורי לתיאור קשיים ולחצים משמעותיים העומדים בפני תעשיית הרכב.

tasks.prompt: What range does Bentley claim for the Torcal's 113kWh battery?
options: Up to 162 miles
Up to 203 miles
Up to 300 miles
Up to 375 miles
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בנטלי טוענת שסוללת ה־113 קוט״ש מאפשרת טווח של עד 375 מייל, שהם כ־600 ק״מ.

tasks.prompt: What does “future-proof the industry” most nearly mean?
options: Prepare the industry to remain successful as technology and demand change
Guarantee that every future car will be built by hand
Protect factories from physical damage caused by storms
Stop companies from introducing any new models
tasks.correct_answer: Prepare the industry to remain successful as technology and demand change
tasks.explanation_hebrew: future-proof פירושו להתאים את התעשייה לשינויים עתידיים כדי שתוכל להמשיך לפעול ולהצליח.

tasks.prompt: Why did the government say the Torcal investment could help the wider supply chain?
options: Bentley plans to buy all components from one overseas supplier.
More than 700 businesses supply Bentley, including 82 close to Crewe.
The new car will not require any manufactured parts.
Every UK car factory will build part of the Torcal.
tasks.correct_answer: More than 700 businesses supply Bentley, including 82 close to Crewe.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מציינת שלבנטלי יותר מ־700 ספקים, ובהם 82 עסקים ברדיוס של 50 מייל מקרו, ולכן ההשקעה עשויה לחזק את שרשרת האספקה.

tasks.prompt: Give two performance or charging facts about the Torcal mentioned in the article.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שני נתונים מדויקים מן הכתבה בנוגע לטווח, טעינה, מהירות מרבית או תאוצה.
expected_points: The battery range is up to 375 miles (600km).
It can charge from 10% to 80% in under 20 minutes with a 400kW charger.
The Torcal S can reach 162mph and accelerate to 60mph in 2.8 seconds.
The standard model can reach 155mph and accelerate to 60mph in 3.3 seconds.

tasks.prompt: Why is building the Torcal in Crewe important for the local economy?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: התשובה צריכה להסיק מן הכתבה לפחות השפעה מקומית אחת ולבסס אותה בפרט עובדתי.
expected_points: The investment is expected to support 4,000 high-value local jobs.
Nearby suppliers may benefit because 82 supplier businesses are within 50 miles.
The upgraded production line keeps advanced manufacturing activity at Bentley's long-standing Crewe headquarters.

tasks.prompt: Summarise Bentley's Torcal announcement in three or four sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול את סוג הרכב, מקום הייצור, ההשקעה או השדרוג, ולפחות נתון אחד על הרכב או ההשפעה הכלכלית.
expected_points: The Torcal is Bentley's first fully electric car.
It will be produced on a new line at the Crewe factory after a £350m investment.
The vehicle combines luxury with electric performance and fast charging.
The project is expected to support jobs and suppliers.

tasks.prompt: Using evidence from the article, explain one potential benefit and one challenge of Bentley's move into electric cars.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: התשובה צריכה להציג תועלת ואתגר נפרדים, להביא ראיה מן הכתבה לכל אחד, ולהסביר את הקשר.
expected_points: Benefits may include jobs, stronger supply chains, modernised production or preparation for the EV transition.
Challenges may include difficult conditions in the UK motor industry or calls to slow the move to a fully electric future.
The response should use article evidence rather than a general opinion.
